hypotheses.title: Market Correlation Decoupling and Idiosyncratic Quality Divergence (model51)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Exploits low market integration (-correlation_last_60_days_spy). Equities that decouple from broad market movements (SPY) provide natural diversification. Evaluating rolling market correlation via intra-subindustry z-score and subtracting the 20-day price mean-reversion z-score isolates idiosyncratic outperformance during market dislocations, targeting turnover ~11% and zero factor correlation to past models.
confounders: Sudden macro liquidity shocks that cause all asset correlations to converge to 1.0
Protracted market-wide momentum where low-correlation equities lag broad index performance
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during broad market-wide beta momentum rallies where all equities move in lockstep with the benchmark index.

hypotheses.title: Call vs Put Implied Volatility Sentiment Skew Divergence (option8)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Evaluates the 20-day Call-to-Put implied volatility spread ((implied_volatility_call_20 - implied_volatility_put_20) / (implied_volatility_mean_20 + 0.001)). When informed institutional investors position for upside expansion, short-term call IV rises relative to put IV. Standardizing this sentiment spread within subindustries and subtracting 20-day price deviation captures high-conviction options demand while dampening turnover and drawdowns.
confounders: Event-driven earnings announcements causing artificial short-term IV spikes across both calls and puts
Options illiquidity in lower-volume equities producing noisy implied volatility surfaces
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if elevated call IV reflects speculative retail frenzy rather than informed institutional capital positioning.

hypotheses.title: Dividend Yield Cash-Solvency Anchor and Pullback Divergence (analyst4)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Firms with high quarterly dividend yield relative to closing price (ts_backfill(actual_dividend_value_qua, 60) / close) demonstrate robust operational cash distribution capacity and balance sheet discipline. Standardizing dividend yield within subindustries and subtracting 20-day price deviation enters high-yielding companies on oversold pullbacks, suppressing turnover to ~10% and driving Fitness > 1.55 with zero correlation to option or beta surfaces.
confounders: Distressed companies maintaining high trailing dividend yield right before dividend cuts
Ex-dividend date price drops creating temporary artificial price distortions
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during high-growth speculative market rallies where zero-dividend growth tech massively outperforms high-dividend value equities.
